title.zh: 将黎刹省圣马特奥市镇安皮德小学的名称变更为Vicente Santiago小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Ampid Elementary School in the Municipality of San Mateo, Province of Rizal, To Vicente Santiago Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Ampid Elementary School in the Municipality of San Mateo, Province of Rizal, To Vicente Santiago Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Ampid tại Thị trấn San Mateo, Tỉnh Rizal thành Trường tiểu học Vicente Santiago
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Ampid ในเทศบาล San Mateo, จังหวัด Rizal เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Vicente Santiago
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Ampid di Kotamadya San Mateo, Provinsi Rizal menjadi Sekolah Dasar Vicente Santiago
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Ampid di Perbandaran San Mateo, Wilayah Rizal menjadi Sekolah Rendah Vicente Santiago

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7491_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Ampid Elementary School located in the Municipality of San Mateo, Province of Rizal, is hereby changed to Vicente Santiago Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
